jobs_results.title: QA Tester for Apps (Full remote within Spain)
jobs_results.description:
We're looking for a QA Tester who is passionate about their work, adapts easily, and shares our company values!

A little bit about us

Leadtech has been fostering and developing innovative digital businesses across several industries since 2009. It has since then expanded to a team of over 500 committed employees working all over Spain. We are thrilled to have more than 23 nationalities working together and very proud to see that our products and services are enjoyed by millions of users monthly around the globe.

How will you make a difference
• Manage, prepare and monitor testing and its push through production, in an agile environment
• Together with the QA team define and prepare the strategy to improve the quality of our products
• Work closely with the business and engineering team to provide ideas of improvement
• Share your experience and knowledge with the QA team

Your team

We're team-first. If you believe in the power of collaboration and that the team's success is your... success, then you're one of us!

Fun is fundamental. We believe in forming strong bonds in and outside the office. That's why we have a team-building budget and organize activities to enjoy ourselves.

Positivity wins the day. Bring a positive attitude and communicate openly. Self-awareness and an openness to learn are always a plus.

Requirements

What will make you stand out from the crowd:
• At least 2 years experience working as a QA Tester.
• Experience in validation of APPS like IOS
• Strong experience in software Quality Assurance test plan and test case generation.
• Experience in Agile methodologies and working in a multidisciplinary team is desirable.
• Ability to report and document clearly.
• Experience in working with bug-tracking software.
• Knowledge of programming languages.
• Interest in testing industry trends.
• Good English and Spanish skills.
• Team player.

Benefits

Perks of being one of us:
• Top-notch private health insurance — includes dental and psychological services
• Full-time, permanent contract
• Flexible time off, no blackout dates, plus your birthday, Christmas' Eve and New Year's Eve off
• Remote work OR come into the office if you prefer!
• Flextime (7 - 9:30 a.m. / 3:30 - 7:30 p.m)
• Free Friday afternoons (a 7-hour workday!) + 35-hour week in July and August (free afternoons here we come!)
• Enhanced career path designed just for you
• External training budget
• Other: ticket restaurant, nursery tickets
• Budget for team-building activities
• We celebrate all company landmarks
• And when you come into the office, you'll get free coffee and snacks, fresh fruit, and can enjoy our game room and the cool terrace overlooking the Mediterranean

Sounds good? Apply now! We're looking forward to getting to know you.

Location

Our exceptional offices are in Barcelona's Blue Building, right on the city's seafront. Besides our stunning views, you'll enjoy perks such as free fruit, snacks, and coffee and will be able to take part in our game competitions.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment.

The personal data you provide will be used solely to manage your candidacy for the purposes of this position. You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, or cancellation by sending a letter to Avenida Litoral, 12-14, 5ta planta, Barcelona 08005. Additionally, you can email us at protecciondedatos@LeadTech.com, including documentation proving your identity

jobs_results.title: Tester
jobs_results.description:
D365 Programme Test Lead

Barcelona

Our Client is embarking on a multi-year global finance transformation programme (EOS). The program involves three main pillars - Internal Controls, Management Reporting, and ERP. This includes global deployment of CCH Tagetik (Corporate Performance Management finance transformation platform), and Microsoft Dynamics 365 to approximately 20 different business units.

You will lead and manage the finance transformation’s testing stream and provide guidance, advice and support to the transformation programme in areas of requirements, documentation, testing and traceability. You will possess strong planning, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to listen and influence. You will also have in-depth practical knowledge of project and programme management methodologies, tools and techniques.

This role will suit an exceptional communicator with resilience and tenacity and the ability to work effectively at all levels in an... organisation.

Key Responsibilities
- Ownership for the programme testing function across multiple streams of the finance transformation, and work with other transformation programmes to coordinate on organisation test strategy
- Lead testing activities, using a structured approach
- Promote and advocate test capabilities within the programme and within the wider organisation
- Defining, implementing and managing the: test strategy, test resource plan, test environments’ requirements, test data approach, test reporting and entry/exit criteria
- Work with teams responsible for planning, requirements, design, development, environment and release management, cybersecurity, support, change management, and other related areas to ensure that deliverables to and from the test function support our test strategy and overall quality assurance objectives
- Provide reports and progress updates in a variety of formats for various stakeholder groups
- Take responsibility for talent, succession planning and supplier management in the areas of testing and test assurance
- Work with stakeholders in multiple countries to determine the contribution that the test function can make to achieving and assuring business objectives
- Work with suppliers to ensure consistency and robustness in how they and the test function support robust delivery
- Help shape the value proposition for the test function, and define the roles and responsibilities for the test resources, both within the core transformation team and those performing test roles within vendor and country teams
- Work with the BA Team Lead to ensure requirements are captured in a testable, prioritised way, thereby supporting the execution of a suitably risk-based approach to testing
- Support training efforts by working with the Training Manager to ensure testing and training efforts are well coordinated, particularly in how they both contribute to positive user adoption
• *Skills and Experience**

Required
- Must be an experienced Programme level Testing Lead rather than specific project testing lead or manager.
- ISTQB certified International Software Testing Qualifications Board
- Experience in a previous programme test leadership role and can work in high pressured environments.
- Writing and briefing of the programme test strategy for finance transformation programmes of comparable size and shape
- Multiple ERP and MIS implementation projects, including multi-country deployments and at least one project deploying Dynamics 365 (Microsoft Business Planning Application)
- Understanding of the pros and cons of different implementation methodologies, including Waterfall and different flavours of Agile
- Experience managing the test function whilst working with an external implementation partner
- Excellent analytical and creative problem-solving skills
- Ability to influence others and move toward a common vision or goal
- Ability to establish and maintain strong relationships
- Keeping calm, adapting and responding to change and events which are inevitable in an operational business
- Positive outlook and optimistic disposition
- Highly organised with a professional, agile and diligent nature
- Flexible and adaptable; able to work in ambiguous situations
- Experience of working with remote stakeholders
- Hold a passport or visa allowing you to travel across Europe for workshops without restriction

Desirable
- Experience implementing a combined D365 global ERP projects and finance projects.
- Experience working within similar industries to the client.
- Other European languages
• *Job Types**: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: 70,000.72€ - 120,000.60€ per year
• *Experience**:

- Testing or Test Manager: 5 years (required)
- D365 ERP OR SAP ERP: 5 years (required)
- Finance and Operation or F&O: 5 years (required)

Work Location: Remote

- Jornada intensiva los viernes y en verano.

jobs_results.title: QA Tester
jobs_results.description:
Oportunidad de empleo: QA Tester
Empresa

El Cliente es una empresa de servicios financieros con formato híbrido en Madrid, especializada en ofrecer soluciones innovadoras y eficientes. Nos destacamos por nuestra dedicación y compromiso en brindar a nuestros clientes la mejor experiencia posible.
Descripción del puesto

Estamos buscando un QA Tester altamente capacitado para unirse a nuestro equipo. Como QA Tester, serás responsable de garantizar la calidad y el rendimiento de nuestros productos y sistemas. Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con los equipos de desarrollo y los analistas de negocio para identificar y solucionar cualquier problema en nuestros software y aplicaciones.
Requisitos
• Experiencia mínima de 3 años como QA Tester en entornos financieros o similares.
• Sólidos conocimientos en técnicas de pruebas manuales.
• Amplio dominio de herramientas de gestión de proyectos como JIRA.
• Excelente nivel de inglés (tanto escrito como hablado).
• Capacidad para trabajar en... equipo y comunicarse eficazmente.
• Orientado/a a los detalles y con excelentes habilidades analíticas.
• Fuertes habilidades de resolución de problemas y capacidad para adaptarse a entornos cambiantes.
Responsabilidades
• Diseñar y ejecutar casos de prueba manuales para garantizar la calidad de los productos y sistemas.
• Realizar el seguimiento y la resolución de problemas en colaboración con los equipos de desarrollo.
• Participar en la identificación y mitigación de riesgos relacionados con la calidad y el rendimiento.
• Colaborar estrechamente con los analistas de negocio para comprender los requisitos y objetivos del cliente.
• Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con el equipo de desarrollo para proporcionar retroalimentación constante sobre la calidad del software y las posibles mejoras.
• Mantenerse actualizado/a sobre las últimas tendencias y mejores prácticas en pruebas de software.
Beneficios
• Salario competitivo y paquete de beneficios atractivo.
• Oportunidades de crecimiento y desarrollo profesional en un entorno dinámico.
• Trabajar junto a un equipo altamente calificado y colaborativo.
• Participar en proyectos innovadores y desafiantes.
Cómo aplicar

Si cumples con los requisitos y estás interesado/a en formar parte de nuestro equipo como QA Tester, envíanos tu currículum. Agradecemos de antemano a todos los candidatos/as su interés, sin embargo, solo contactaremos a aquellos que sean seleccionados para una entrevista.

Esperamos recibir tu solicitud y poder conocerte

Requisitos:
• Experiencia realizando pruebas manuales
• Nivel de inglés B2 o superior
• Conocimiento SQL

• Diseñar y ejecutar casos de prueba manuales para garantizar la calidad de los productos y sistemas.
• Realizar el seguimiento y la resolución de problemas en colaboración con los equipos de desarrollo.
• Participar en la identificación y mitigación de riesgos relacionados con la calidad y el rendimiento.
• Colaborar estrechamente con los analistas de negocio para comprender los requisitos y objetivos del cliente.
• Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con el equipo de desarrollo para proporcionar retroalimentación constante sobre la calidad del software y las posibles mejoras.
• Mantenerse actualizado/a sobre las últimas tendencias y mejores prácticas en pruebas de software.
Beneficios
• Salario competitivo y paquete de beneficios atractivo.
• Oportunidades de crecimiento y desarrollo profesional en un entorno dinámico.
• Trabajar junto a un equipo altamente calificado y colaborativo.
• Participar en proyectos innovadores y desafiantes.
Cómo aplicar

Si cumples con los requisitos y estás interesado/a en formar parte de nuestro equipo como QA Tester, envíanos tu currículum. Agradecemos de antemano a todos los candidatos/as su interés, sin embargo, solo contactaremos a aquellos que sean seleccionados para una entrevista.

Esperamos recibir tu solicitud y poder conocerte

Requisitos:
• Experiencia realizando pruebas manuales
• Nivel de inglés B2 o superior
• Conocimiento SQL

• Soporte a equipos de gestión de contenidos web.

• Inglés (nivel alto hablado y escrito).
• Experiencia con herramientas de comprobación de accesibilidad web (TAW Monitor, Wave, o similares) y documental (Adobe Acrobat, o similares).
• Experiencia con rastreadores web como Screaming Frog, OnCrawl, o similares.
• Conocimientos básicos de HTML, CSS, JavaScript y Phyton.
• Experiencia con herramientas de SEO (como Google Search Console, ScreamingFrog, OnCrawl, u otras similares).
• Conocimientos y experiencia en gestión de contenidos web (valorable experiencia en CMS).
• Conocimientos básicos de analítica web y medición de datos.
• Experiencia en QA Testing y procesos de automatización de pruebas.
